    | timestamp = 00:12:29.720
    | text      = These guys are kind of bumbling boobs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:31.440
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:32.440
    | text      = And this sushi date, you would not expect that we would be where we are in 2025.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:37.799
    | text      = That's for sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:38.799
    | text      = How about that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:39.799
    | text      = Also, I don't know if Alex knows how to use chopsticks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:42.440
    | text      = That I, I, I would strongly suggest he does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.559
    | text      = He gestures well with them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:47.799
    | text      = I will I will give him that much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:49.200
    | text      = I would almost say that if I were Alex, I would not learn how to use chopsticks on principle.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:55.399
    | text      = You know?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.399
    | text      = Well, I mean, I think that he would say something about his sister being Korean adopted.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:02.360
    | text      = So there you go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:03.720
    | text      = I'll take it back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:05.240
    | text      = So we start in the middle, essentially.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:09.879
    | text      = This behind the scenes featurette begins in the middle of a conversation that they're
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:15.440
    | text      = having.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:16.440
    | text      = And Joe is talking about like, why weed is illegal, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:19.320
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:20.320
    | text      = They're all just afraid of hemp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:21.320
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:22.320
    | text      = And the only reason why most of these drugs are illegal anyways, because we can't control
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:26.200
    | text      = them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:27.200
    | text      = Your marijuana is illegal now because they can't tax it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:30.480
    | text      = Maybe because they can't stop you from growing it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:32.679
    | text      = It's illegal now because you can't grow it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:33.679
    | text      = Well, George Washington grew it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:34.679
    | text      = Well, we all know the whole deal behind it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:37.399
    | text      = The reason why it was made illegal in the first place is because they came up with a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:40.840
    | text      = method of producing pulp from hemp that was much more efficient.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:46.759
    | text      = The way they used to do it back when hemp was a viable crop and it was used by farmers
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:51.980
    | text      = all across the country when they made paper out of it, when they made clothing out of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:55.960
    | text      = it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:56.960
    | text      = Sales.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:57.960
    | text      = It was all collected by slaves and it was all processed by slaves, but that's not very
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:04.039
    | text      = cost effective once slavery became illegal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:06.240
    | text      = So hemp died off and cotton took hold.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:08.279
    | text      = Now in the 1930s, in the cover of Popular Science magazine, they had an article that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:12.879
    | text      = said hemp, the new billion dollar crop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:15.279
    | text      = And they were talking about how this new, I think it was called the de-corticator.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:17.679
    | text      = I forget what it's called, but it was a new machine that they had invented that made it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:21.879
    | text      = much more efficient to process the pulp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:24.320
    | text      = And they were going to make superior paper products, superior cloth.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:28.519
    | text      = It was also when DuPont came up with a chemical composition for nylon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:32.320
    | text      = Now what they did was, William Randolph Hearst, not only did he own newspapers, he also owned
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:37.120
    | text      = paper plants where he made paper.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:39.500
    | text      = And if hemp is a superior paper and everyone's using hemp, he would have had to transfer
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:43.200
    | text      = all of his lumber yards and all of his paper plants to processing hemp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:48.559
    | text      = That would have cost millions of dollars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:50.480
    | text      = So what did they do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:51.480
    | text      = Instead they went after the other thing that hemp does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:54.519
    | text      = It actually intoxicates you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:55.919
    | text      = And they financed, well, you have one right to ask.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:58.639
    | text      = On fear.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:59.639
    | text      = They did it based on fear.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:00.639
    | text      = They said Mexicans and blacks are smoking marijuana.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:03.799
    | text      = They called it the slang term.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:04.960
    | text      = They didn't call it cannabis.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:05.960
    | text      = They didn't call it hemp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:06.960
    | text      = They didn't call it things that people would be familiar with.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:09.200
    | text      = They called it the slang that Mexicans used.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:11.200
    | text      = There's a drug called marijuana and these people are smoking it and they want to rape
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:14.720
    | text      = white women.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:15.720
    | text      = And they started passing laws.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:16.720
    | text      = They made films where you smoke your turban.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:18.720
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:19.720
    | text      = I've got all of them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:20.960
    | text      = I've got a lot of them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:21.960
    | text      = I've got a lot of them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:22.960
    | text      = I've got a bunch of them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:23.960
    | text      = And they're fantastic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:24.960
    | text      = They're brilliantly stupid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:25.960
    | text      = So what Joe is expressing here is very interesting because a lot of it's true but some of it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:33.440
    | text      = is also a strong argument against Alex's fundamental worldview.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:37.879
    | text      = It's absolutely correct that the war on drugs and the criminalization of weed were political
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:41.759
    | text      = and specifically racist developments in our country.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:44.980
    | text      = Nixon's domestic policy chief John Ehrlichman laid it out quite explicitly in an interview
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:49.320
    | text      = he did with Harper's in 1994.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:51.320
    | text      = Quote, the Nixon campaign in 1968 and the White House after that had two enemies, the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:56.879
    | text      = anti-war left and black people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:58.720
    | text      = You understand what I'm saying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:00.159
    | text      = We knew we couldn't make it illegal to be either against the war or black.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:03.799
    | text      = But by getting the public to associate the hippies with marijuana and the blacks with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:07.080
    | text      = heroin and then criminalizing both heavily, we could disrupt those communities.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:11.600
    | text      = We could arrest their leaders, raid their homes, break up their meetings and vilify
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:14.879
    | text      = them night after night on the evening news.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:17.320
    | text      = Did we know we were lying about drugs?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:19.000
    | text      = Of course we did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:20.399
    | text      = A great deal of the hysteria around drugs comes down to this type of exploitation, like
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:24.580
    | text      = how the 1875 anti-opium laws in San Francisco were largely a covert effort at attacking
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:30.440
    | text      = the growing Chinese immigrant population there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:33.460
    | text      = It's actually pretty funny to think about how much of the stuff we see about fentanyl
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:37.659
    | text      = is rooted in this same motivation and how deeply Joe is invested in creating propaganda
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:42.980
    | text      = around that issue that really is the modern day equivalent to all those reefer madness
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:47.600
    | text      = films he rightfully mocked in this 2003 rant.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:51.639
    | text      = He's become the thing he always knew was stupid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:55.240
    | text      = This whole part about hemp being a magic product and threatening William Randolph Hearst's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:59.080
    | text      = paper factories, that's a little bit less historically based, but it might be Joe trying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:03.580
    | text      = to come up with a larger financial explanation for why certain actions in history were taken
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:08.799
    | text      = as a way to absolve the past of being so damn racist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:13.680
    | text      = Hemp is a versatile crop, and even though Joe overstates how it could replace so many
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:18.079
    | text      = other markets, it did get an unfair shake in terms of the whole market.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:23.079
    | text      = A lot of that is due less to Hearst's machinations and has more to do with the history of industrial
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:28.200
    | text      = hemp production in the United States.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:30.759
    | text      = There was some domestic production, but it was largely propped up by tariffs on importing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:35.519
    | text      = bast fibers from other countries.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:38.640
    | text      = That tariff was dropped in 1872, and that had a crushing effect on the US hemp production,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:43.720
    | text      = so you could just get other shit from other countries at the same or lesser price.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:48.480
    | text      = Yeah, it's cheaper.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:49.680
    | text      = But in the later 1800s and into the early 1900s, a huge opportunity arose with the invention
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:55.480
    | text      = of the self-binding harvester.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:57.640
    | text      = Now farmers needed shitloads of high quality twine to use in their binding machines, and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:02.400
    | text      = hemp was perfect for that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:04.359
    | text      = This led to the United States Department of Agriculture exploring ways to build up the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:08.640
    | text      = production of American hemp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:11.220
    | text      = There was promise, and there was some breeding of strains that was really showing a lot of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:18.599
    | text      = potential, but then the Great Depression came and really shifted everyone's priorities about
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:22.839
    | text      = land usage, and hemp became not really as important anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:26.599
    | text      = Imported, cheaper, possibly lower quality fibers were fine in this context, and the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:32.079
    | text      = bottom more or less fell out of the building of the industrial hemp base.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:36.759
    | text      = There were attempts at making hemp a wider-grown crop, but the timing was just really bad for
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:41.240
    | text      = it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:42.240
    | text      = It never really made a comeback before the Marijuana Tax Act of 1937 was imposed, and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:46.640
    | text      = racist attitudes and stigma toward weed rubbed off on hemp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:50.559
    | text      = It didn't help that DuPont had developed nylon in the late 30s, but Joe doesn't have a basis
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:55.900
    | text      = for claiming that efforts to prop up big nylon were behind the diminishing of hemp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:00.200
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:01.319
    | text      = The popular science article that Joe is referencing is actually from Popular Mechanics, and it's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:05.240
    | text      = about the promise of a new machine that he got the name right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:08.960
    | text      = It was the Decorticator.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:11.000
    | text      = This machine solved the problem of hemp being far more labor-intensive to process than other
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:16.359
    | text      = fibers that are comparable, but it wasn't a miracle solution.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:21.480
    | text      = Even this article that Joe is referencing says, quote, One obstacle to the onward march
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:25.759
    | text      = of hemp is the reluctance of farmers to try new crops.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:29.220
    | text      = The problem is complicated by the need for proper equipment at a reasonable distance
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:33.140
    | text      = from the farm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:34.400
    | text      = The machine cannot be operated profitably unless there's enough acreage within driving
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:38.900
    | text      = range, and farmers cannot find a profitable market unless there's machinery to handle
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:42.900
    | text      = the crop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:44.299
    | text      = This headline that Joe remembers is from an article that's discussing the potential gains
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:48.380
    | text      = that could come from industrial hemp production replacing our reliance on foreign fibers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:53.660
    | text      = Even in that body of the article, they discuss how it's not a sure thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:57.579
    | text      = This machine did not live up to the promises that were imagined.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:03.019
    | text      = The bigger picture here is that a belief that DuPont and Hurst not liking hemp leading to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:07.880
    | text      = hemp being crushed despite it being a miracle crop requires a belief that the free market
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:12.700
    | text      = doesn't exist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:14.440
    | text      = That might be okay for Joe in 2003, but not Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:18.859
    | text      = He can't possibly incorporate this into his strong defense of laissez-faire capitalist
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:28.740
    | text      = kind of attitudes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:29.740
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:30.740
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:31.740
    | text      = I mean, you would have to expand your definition of the market to include existence, all existence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:38.539
    | text      = The free market is fine because these guys can steal from you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:41.180
    | text      = Oh, is that part of the free market?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:43.259
    | text      = So much of the defense of the idea of like government not intervening and stuff and it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:48.619
    | text      = has to do with like the market will figure it out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:50.940
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:51.940
    | text      = You know, like, and no, it won't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:54.259
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:55.259
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:56.259
    | text      = If you believe that DuPont being really rich and having this thing that the free market
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:02.900
    | text      = doesn't sort this out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:04.019
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:05.019
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = He's too old.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:24.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:25.000
    | text      = You're too old for this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:26.000
    | text      = I'm too old for this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:27.199
    | text      = I don't want freak out the squares from my, uh, right wing dumb shit, uh, conspiracy podcaster.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:34.800
    | text      = You can be in Fugazi for four to six years.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:37.780
    | text      = The end.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:38.780
    | text      = Then you got to grow up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:40.360
    | text      = So Joe has some interesting political positions that he expresses in this conversation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:45.440
    | text      = They, they're still a fucking mess.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:48.480
    | text      = The people at the highest levels of government are still slaves to government.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:51.280
    | text      = I mean, it's, it's really a bureaucracy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:53.280
    | text      = It's a machine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:54.280
    | text      = Of course.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:55.280
    | text      = It's completely out of control.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:56.559
    | text      = It's such a, it's such a huge monster right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:58.880
    | text      = It's so completely out of control.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:00.519
    | text      = There's no, how are you going to control it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:01.519
    | text      = What are you going to do about it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:02.519
    | text      = How are you ever going to change it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:04.099
    | text      = It's so fucked up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:05.099
    | text      = Just the electoral college.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:06.099
    | text      = How about that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:07.099
    | text      = How about that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:08.099
    | text      = It just makes you feel so helpless about voting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:10.880
    | text      = You know, just the, the, the way they process one man, one vote doesn't even exist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:15.360
    | text      = Look, our whole system is fuck.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:17.980
    | text      = The whole idea that the commission for presidential debates is a privately funded institution.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:22.400
    | text      = So that means the people that are debating on television that are, that are running for
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:27.699
    | text      = president that that debate is being funded by the very people who will benefit from only
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:33.480
    | text      = certain people being in office.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:35.039
    | text      = Well, Ralph Nader was on the list to speak and they just decided last minute.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:39.039
    | text      = They changed it to 15% where it was 5% before, but then Ross Perot got it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:43.440
    | text      = It used to be 5% of the popular vote in the polls.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:46.079
    | text      = And then you got to think who the fuck votes in the polls.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:48.039
    | text      = You have to be an idiot to vote in the polls.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:50.079
    | text      = And anyway, you have to be so deep into the whole thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:52.119
    | text      = I've never been called for a poll.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:54.119
    | text      = Oh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:55.119
    | text      = Have you?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:56.119
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:57.119
    | text      = I don't even know if they exist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:58.119
    | text      = They might not exist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:59.119
    | text      = They might be all fake, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:00.760
    | text      = Yeah, who knows?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:02.440
    | text      = So I feel like Joe might not really be all that interested in the clear solution to these
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:07.280
    | text      = two problems anymore, which would be abolishing the electoral college and public financing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:11.440
    | text      = of political campaigns.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:12.760
    | text      = Yeah, it seems obvious.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:14.119
    | text      = In this election cycle, he arguably made millions of dollars in campaign contributions to Trump
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:19.679
    | text      = by having him advance on his show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:21.400
    | text      = And he's buddied up with Elon, who gave Trump hundreds of millions of dollars for the election.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:26.079
    | text      = Whatever concern he's expressing about the Commission for Presidential Debates being
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:29.800
    | text      = a private company, that's not part of his politics anymore at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:33.820
    | text      = The Commission on Presidential Debates, it started in 1987.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:39.320
    | text      = And prior to that, the presidential debates were sponsored by the League of Women Voters.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:43.800
    | text      = Prior to JFK and Nixon in 1960, there weren't televised debates.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:47.639
    | text      = And after Nixon came off so bad in that one, there weren't big debates until 1976.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:53.320
    | text      = There was a 16-year lull.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:55.880
    | text      = The CPD is a nonprofit, and it was originally run by co-chairs who were respectively the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:02.079
    | text      = heads of the Democratic and Republican parties.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:04.880
    | text      = It was never meant to include third-party candidates, and the coordination between the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:09.280
    | text      = two parties actually led to the League of Women Voters putting out a press release in
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:13.280
    | text      = 1988, saying, quote, it has become clear to us that the candidates' organizations aim
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:18.519
    | text      = to add debates to their list of campaign trail charades, devoid of substance, spontaneity,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:24.280
    | text      = and honest answers to tough questions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:26.400
    | text      = The League has no intention of becoming an accessory to the hoodwinking of the American
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:30.480
    | text      = public.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:31.480
    | text      = Wow, it's a good thing things have gotten a lot better since then.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:33.280
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:34.280
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:35.280
    | text      = So the H.W. Bush and Dukakis campaigns had agreed to a bunch of demands that they would
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:38.619
    | text      = make of the League, including the right to choose who could ask questions and the, quote,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:43.159
    | text      = composition of the audience.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:45.039
    | text      = The League said fuck off, and since then the Commission on Presidential Debates has sponsored
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:49.559
    | text      = the events until 2024, when Biden and Trump decided that they didn't want to play along
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:53.880
    | text      = with the CPD, and now it's probably dead in the water.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:57.400
    | text      = It's the kind of bullshit that third-party candidates aren't really included, but the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:01.840
    | text      = CPD themselves makes a fairly decent point about it in their about page on their website.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:07.880
    | text      = Quote, candidates for federal office are not required to debate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:11.639
    | text      = History teaches that it's speculative at best to assume that the leading candidates would
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:15.280
    | text      = agree to share the stage with candidates enjoying only scant public support.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:20.179
    | text      = They just kind of get to arbitrarily decide who's a leading candidate, but they're also
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:25.320
    | text      = right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:26.780
    | text      = Political campaigns are a lot about appearances, so you don't want to look like a loser debating
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:30.840
    | text      = someone who's polling at 6% when you're like at 45.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:34.460
    | text      = They make it clear that, quote, the CPD's debates are not intended to serve as a springboard
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:39.619
    | text      = for a candidate with only scant public support.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:42.780
    | text      = They didn't change their standards to 15% because of Ross Perot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:45.900
    | text      = They just formalized that as a polling threshold in 2000, justified by an argument that this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:51.460
    | text      = was the threshold that the League of Women Voters used previously.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:55.219
    | text      = Before 2000, they didn't let people in who polled over 5%, and if you go to their website,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:00.619
    | text      = you can find a long list of the people who were on their advisory panel for the pre-2000
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:05.440
    | text      = debates and the process they followed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:07.619
    | text      = It was a lot of discussion about what makes a leading candidate who is relevant, who could
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:14.659
    | text      = conceivably win, and matters in terms of the public conversation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:18.420
    | text      = It's not about the 5 or 15% threshold.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:21.500
    | text      = I mean, ultimately, it's about fighting an old man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:26.739
    | text      = Either I get my ass kicked by an old man, that's no good, or I beat the shit out of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:30.780
    | text      = an old man, that's no good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:32.139
    | text      = So why would I debate somebody with 5%?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:34.380
    | text      = That's ridiculous.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:35.460
    | text      = Yeah, and I think that if you have too loose of standards, you're gonna fuck around and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:40.860
    | text      = end up with David Duke making a decent case for why he deserves to be on that stage.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:47.179
    | text      = And I think that's a problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:50.059
    | text      = Do you think Ye couldn't have maybe tried to force something if you were required to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:56.320
    | text      = have people who polled over 5% on the debates?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:59.619
    | text      = The obvious reason I would have to dispute that would just be, yeah, to throw them in
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:07.260
    | text      = there would be to reveal the parts of the campaigns that they don't want to show you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:12.699
    | text      = To have David Duke on stage with you might make you start nodding along with David Duke
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:17.380
    | text      = and then people, you know what I'm saying?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:19.420
    | text      = Well sure, but that is essentially what the CPD's argument is, is like a leading candidate,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:27.579
    | text      = a relevant candidate wouldn't put themselves in that position.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:30.980
    | text      = So we wouldn't be able to do these debates if we just invited folks like David Duke.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:35.940
    | text      = Right, I mean the problem is fundamentally that they recognize their obsolescence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:42.420
    | text      = And I think that a decent argument could be made that Ralph Nader was in theory a leading
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:48.980
    | text      = candidate in the same way that Ron Paul maybe was a leading candidate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:53.860
    | text      = I think that you could make a decent argument that they should have included them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:58.820
    | text      = But the argument that would be successful I don't think follows the same track that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:03.820
    | text      = they're on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:04.820
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:05.820
    | text      = So anyway, Joe in 2003 is right about the system being fucked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:09.340
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:10.340
    | text      = He's wrong about a lot and he accepts easy answers for hard questions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:13.659
    | text      = But at least it feels like he has momentum heading in the right direction.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:17.320
    | text      = Which it doesn't feel like anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:20.460
    | text      = Feels like he has momentum, but it's not good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:25.300
    | text      = So Joe hates money and politics.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:30.260
    | text      = Don't we all?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:31.260
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:32.260
    | text      = How much have we just not allowed?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:33.260
    | text      = Just the fact that people are, you're allowed to contribute money, gigantic sums of money,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:38.460
    | text      = huge corporations that would benefit from these people being, it's obvious that it's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:42.420
    | text      = bought and paid for.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:43.780
    | text      = It's so obvious.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:44.780
    | text      = I mean it's so sick.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:46.300
    | text      = The whole situation is so tough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:48.139
    | text      = So where's it going the next five years?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:49.139
    | text      = It's not going to get any better.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:50.539
    | text      = I'm praying for a meteor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:51.539
    | text      = I think we need a meteor that wipes out about 60% of the people on the planet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:55.260
    | text      = You know, that's like the only way we're going to survive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:57.699
    | text      = I don't know, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:58.699
    | text      = You know, it's just, I think just enjoy yourself and try to have fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:01.500
    | text      = I don't know how much we're going to change.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:04.780
    | text      = I should remind you that Joe had Trump and Vance on his podcast for softball interviews
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:09.139
    | text      = and has made a practice of helping launder the reputations of billionaires who gave vast
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:13.059
    | text      = sums of money to Trump's campaign.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:15.659
    | text      = Whereas once Joe thought that this excessive money in politics was an unsolvable problem
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:20.539
    | text      = that could only be solved by a meteor hitting the earth.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:23.500
    | text      = Now he's stupid rich and he's friends with a bunch of the people who profit from continuing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:27.699
    | text      = that unsolvable problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:29.579
    | text      = Crazy how that works.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:30.579
    | text      = Joe made a choice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:32.179
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:33.179
    | text      = Also Alex should be really mad about this kind of exterminationist talk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:37.059
    | text      = The world's problems could be solved by killing 60% of the population?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:40.780
    | text      = That sounds downright globalist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:42.619
    | text      = It does sound very globalist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:44.059
    | text      = I guess it's fine from Joe though cause he's on Fear Factor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:46.739
    | text      = Well now it even, it makes even more sense since he will have an underground redoubt.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:51.699
    | text      = Is that what I'm under?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:52.699
    | text      = Is that what we understand here?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
